rule_source.raw_answer: 2. Practically similar—a tiny premium for the lighter vessel may exist, but a 5 lb difference alone isn't enough to make a meaningful distinction when everything else matches.

method.rule: radius=max(calibrated_radius,abs(tare_coefficient_for5lb)+1e-8). No coefficient or label changes. Applies to both18- and21-feature models because context terms are tare-independent. No new estimated parameter.
method.validation: Reuse untouched held-out margins; threshold floor determined entirely by each training fit and prior global user rule. Apply to both baseline and candidate, also compare to native v16. Identified after exploratory error inspection, not a new untouched holdout.
method.semantics: This is an operational materiality constraint, not a hard price-equality constraint; small directional preference can remain.
